community_list_entries.name: Episodic Memory Benchmark: Episodic Memories Generation and Evaluation Benchmark for Large Language Models

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Synthetic, contamination-free episodic-memory benchmark (ICLR 2025 per repo). Books of 10k-1M+ tokens contain events cued by time, place, entity and content. It tests recall, latest-state tracking, chronological ordering and confabulation, comparing in-context, RAG and fine-tuning (parametric) memor

phase1_verified_types.parametric: Sec. 5.1: '(3) Parametric Memory via Fine-Tuning, where memory is stored within the model's parameters'. Table 3 scores fine-tuned GPT-4o-mini against in-context and RAG on the same questions (F1 0.83 vs 0.54/0.60 on single-event questions).
